posts.title: IDX: my first impressions
posts.description: "I learned to code on a Chromebook in online editors. My very first Astro project was a forked CodeSandbox of an Astro v0.12 (!) starter template. I have spent the last two years building several websites and maintaining the Astro documentation on Gitpod. Two months ago, I switched to IDX as my exclusive coding environment (and you're not going to believe what happened next...)"
